title: Broker Roundup | August
summary: This month, we’re focused on helping brokers create a smoother path from application to funding while expanding the financing options available to their clients. We’re sharing practical strategies for optimizing deal flow, highlighting Figure’s HELOC offering for qualified homeowners, and introducing Lendflow’s new Dynamic Documents feature for more efficient document collection.From connecting each deal with the right financing options to reducing manual steps throughout the application process, Lendflow helps brokers move opportunities forward more efficiently, strengthen lender relationships, and deliver a better financing experience for their clients.

#### **Featured Article**


‍


#### [How Brokers Can Optimize Deal Flow from Application to Funding](https://www.lendflow.com/post/how-brokers-can-optimize-deal-flow-from-application-to-funding)


A strong deal flow process is about more than generating applications—it’s about keeping qualified opportunities moving efficiently toward funding. In this month’s featured article, we break down ways brokers can optimize each stage of the financing journey, from collecting complete applications and documentation to matching borrowers with the right lenders and maintaining momentum through underwriting.


[Read More >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/how-brokers-can-optimize-deal-flow-from-application-to-funding)


‍


#### **Lender Highlight**


‍


#### [Figure HELOC](https://www.lendflow.com/post/expand-your-financing-options-with-figures-heloc-program)


Expand the financing options you can offer through Lendflow with access to Figure's Home Equity Line of Credit. Through Lendflow's lender network, brokers can connect qualified homeowners with Figure's HELOC offering, providing access to $15,000–$750,000 in home equity with a streamlined online application and funding possible in as few as five days. For brokers looking to build stronger lender relationships and serve a wider range of financing needs, Figure adds a flexible home-equity solution to the mix.


[Learn More >](https://www.lendflow.com/post/expand-your-financing-options-with-figures-heloc-program)

#### [Customize Document Requirements with Dynamic Docs](https://www.lendflow.com/post/customize-document-requirements-with-dynamic-docs)


Dynamic Documents make it easier to standardize document requirements by grouping related documents together and automatically adding them to new deals through Workflow Builder templates.
